rules: Append new dated records; never overwrite historical records.
Keep investor offer, client demand, asking rate and confirmed deal rate separate.
Never label an indicative rate as a confirmed transaction.
Keep plot numbers and client-specific details private unless explicitly approved for publication.
Pair and trail premiums are case-specific and never guaranteed.
Existing website rate figures are not automatically imported as verified historical records.
